response.justification: Despite extensive experience, Bogdan is overqualified and misaligned with the junior/mid-level role; his senior titles, deep expertise in DLang and embedded systems, and lack of PostgreSQL/React/Nest.js focus contradict the job’s stack and scale, while his German language barrier and high on-site requirement further reduce fit.
strengths: Extensive full-stack TypeScript and Node.js experience across multiple roles
Proven ability to build scalable systems and integrate diverse data sources
Strong open-source contributions and architectural thinking with clear documentation
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role with senior titles and leadership history
Lacks demonstrated experience with PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js as required
Basic German proficiency conflicts with high on-site presence requirement in Berlin
